post.description:
Which of these files the caller can already see a copy of.

Asked before uploading, so a file dropped a second time can be caught
and the person asked whether they meant to. Only documents the caller
can see count, a copy in a matter they're not on isn't theirs to be
told about. The earliest copy of each is the one returned.

delete.description: Remove a source. What it already found stays.

Delete a matter along with every document in it.

Documents don't cascade from their matter on purpose, see the note on
Document in app/models.py, so they go first by hand. Their chunks,
metadata and profiles cascade from them, and the matter's parties, dates,
members, pins and views cascade from it. The audit log keeps its entries,
it's the record that any of this happened.
